name: IP ownership and licence question table
summary: Before an agreement or statement of work is signed, IP counsel gets one table of the ownership, assignment, licence, background-IP and confidentiality clauses, each quoted with its section, set against the company's own IP positions and led by whether the assignment words counsel expects were found.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for legal preparation: a named lawyer decides, the company's own counsel-approved positions are the only comparison, and every gap is written as a question.

sources.contribution: Checking the assignment of commissioned work first and putting that check at the top; the difference between a present assignment and a promise to assign; leaving a clause that could be read either way to the attorney rather than settling it; reading the IP terms of an agreement alongside its statements of work; stating the company's side for each agreement and asking rather than inferring it; and treating confidentiality, with return or destruction, as an IP clause family.
